[[File:Bogie.png|thumb|250px|Bogie]]
(Japanese: '''ボギー''' ''Bogie'') is a supporting character who appeared in ''[[M06|Jirachi: Wish Maker]]''. He is a market vendor who travels from place to place to sell souvenirs and other memorabilia. When {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} visited his shop at the [[Millennium Festival]], {{an|May}} expressed interest in Bogie's wishing stars (Japanese: '''ウィッシュメーカー''' ''wishmakers''). Bogie explained to May how the wishing stars worked, after which May decided to buy one. Bogie watched the festival's fireworks together with Ash and his friends.

Much later, when Ash and his friends left [[Forina]] and continued on their journey, Bogie was driving through and offered them a ride after May had collapsed from exhaustion.

==Lookalike==
[[File:Bogie lookalike.png|thumb|250px|The Bogie lookalike in Alamos Town]]
A character [[Animated series character recycling|strongly resembling Bogie]] later appeared in ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]''. He set up shop in [[Alamos Town]] and began selling [[Lunar Feather|Lunar Wings]]. {{an|Dawn}} visited him and bought one, after he explained the item could ward off bad dreams. This character, however, is only referred to as "old shopkeeper" ({{tt|売店|ばいてん}}のおじさん) in the Japanese credits and "older man" in the English closed captions. He has different voice actors to Bogie in both the English and Japanese versions.
